code: import api from"./api";const PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT="/api/products";export const getAllProducts=()=>{return api.get(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT);};export const getProductById=id=>{return api.get("".concat(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,"/").concat(id));};export const createProduct=productData=>{return api.post(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,productData);};export const updateProduct=(id,productData)=>{return api.put("".concat(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,"/").concat(id),productData);};export const deleteProduct=id=>{return api.delete("".concat(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,"/").concat(id));};export const searchProducts=name=>{return api.get("".concat(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,"/search"),{params:{name}});};export const getProductionSuggestions=()=>{return api.get("".concat(PRODUCTS_ENDPOINT,"/production-suggestions"));};
